C0075.title: Mianzhu Procuratorate Case Series on Illegal Control of Computer Information Systems
keywords: illegal control of computer information systems
C0075.summary: According to Procuratorate Daily, the Mianzhu Procuratorate in Sichuan handled a series of illegal-control-of-computer-information-systems cases and cut off a criminal chain that used traffic hijacking to divert users to overseas gambling and pornography sites. The series involved three traffic hijacking criminal gangs, 11 arrested suspects, and the recovery of more than 12 million yuan in illegal gains including virtual currency. The case shows how network traffic, data-center resources, and promotion settlement can combine into a cross-border black-gray-market traffic-diversion chain, and governance needs to trace technical control, advertisers, and settlement relationships together.
